record.bible_text: He that dasheth in pieces<WH06327><WTH8688> is come up<WH05927><WTH8804> before thy face<WH06440>: keep<WH05341><WTH8800> the munition<WH04694>, watch<WH06822><WTH8761> the way<WH01870>, make <FI>thy<Fi> loins<WH04975> strong<WH02388><WTH8761>, fortify<WH0553><WTH8761> <FI>thy<Fi> power<WH03581> mightily<WH03966>. <RF>He...: or, The disperser, or, hammer<Rf>

For the LORD<WH03068> hath turned away<WH07725><WTH8804> the excellency<WH01347> of Jacob<WH03290>, as the excellency<WH01347> of Israel<WH03478>: for the emptiers<WH01238><WTH8802> have emptied them out<WH01238><WTH8804>, and marred<WH07843><WTH8765> their vine branches<WH02156>. <RF>the excellency of Jacob...: or, the pride of Jacob as the pride, etc<Rf>

The shield<WH04043> of his mighty men<WH01368> is made red<WH0119><WTH8794>, the valiant<WH02428> men<WH0582> <FI>are<Fi> in scarlet<WH08529><WTH8794>: the chariots<WH07393> <FI>shall be<Fi> with flaming<WH0784> torches<WH06393> in the day<WH03117> of his preparation<WH03559><WTH8687>, and the fir trees<WH01265> shall be terribly shaken<WH07477><WTH8717>. <RF>in scarlet: or, dyed scarlet<Rf> <RF>flaming: or, fiery<Rf>

The chariots<WH07393> shall rage<WH01984><WTH8704> in the streets<WH02351>, they shall justle one against another<WH08264><WTH8698> in the broad ways<WH07339>: they shall seem<WH04758> like torches<WH03940>, they shall run<WH07323><WTH8787> like the lightnings<WH01300>. <RF>they: Heb. their show<Rf>

He shall recount<WH02142><WTH8799> his worthies<WH0117>: they shall stumble<WH03782><WTH8735> in their walk<WH01979>; they shall make haste<WH04116><WTH8762> to the wall<WH02346> thereof, and the defence<WH05526><WTH8802> shall be prepared<WH03559><WTH8717>. <RF>worthies: or, gallants<Rf> <RF>defence: Heb. covering, or, coverer<Rf>
The gates<WH08179> of the rivers<WH05104> shall be opened<WH06605><WTH8738>, and the palace<WH01964> shall be dissolved<WH04127><WTH8738>. <RF>dissolved: or, molten<Rf>

And Huzzab<WH05324><WTH8717> shall be led away captive<WH01540><WTH8795>, she shall be brought up<WH05927><WTH8717>, and her maids<WH0519> shall lead<WH05090><WTH8764> <FI>her<Fi> as with the voice<WH06963> of doves<WH03123>, tabering<WH08608><WTH8781> upon their breasts<WH03824>. <RF>Huzzab: or, that which was established, or, there was a stand made<Rf> <RF>led...: or, discovered<Rf>

But Nineveh<WH05210> <FI>is<Fi> of old<WH03117> like a pool<WH01295> of water<WH04325>: yet they shall flee away<WH05127><WTH8801>. Stand<WH05975><WTH8798>, stand<WH05975><WTH8798>, <FI>shall they cry<Fi> ; but none shall look back<WH06437><WTH8688>. <RF>of old: or, from the days that she hath been<Rf> <RF>look back: or, cause them to turn<Rf>

Take ye the spoil<WH0962><WTH8798> of silver<WH03701>, take the spoil<WH0962><WTH8798> of gold<WH02091>: for <FI>there is<Fi> none end<WH07097> of the store<WH08498> <FI>and<Fi> glory<WH03519> out of all the pleasant<WH02532> furniture<WH03627>. <RF>for...: or, and their infinite store, etc<Rf> <RF>pleasant...: Heb. vessels of desire<Rf>

She is empty<WH0950>, and void<WH04003>, and waste<WH01110><WTH8794>: and the heart<WH03820> melteth<WH04549><WTH8738>, and the knees<WH01290> smite together<WH06375>, and much pain<WH02479> <FI>is<Fi>  in all loins<WH04975>, and the faces<WH06440> of them all gather<WH06908><WTH8765> blackness<WH06289>.<CM>

Where <FI>is<Fi> the dwelling<WH04583> of the lions<WH0738>, and the feedingplace<WH04829> of the young lions<WH03715>, where the lion<WH0738>, <FI>even<Fi> the old lion<WH03833>, walked<WH01980><WTH8804>, <FI>and<Fi> the lion's<WH0738> whelp<WH01482>, and none made <FI>them<Fi> afraid<WH02729><WTH8688>?

The lion<WH0738> did tear in pieces<WH02963><WTH8802> enough<WH01767> for his whelps<WH01484>, and strangled<WH02614><WTH8764> for his lionesses<WH03833>, and filled<WH04390><WTH8762> his holes<WH02356> with prey<WH02964>, and his dens<WH04585> with ravin<WH02966>.

Behold, I <FI>am<Fi> against thee, saith<WH05002><WTH8803> the LORD<WH03068> of hosts<WH06635>, and I will burn<WH01197><WTH8689> her chariots<WH07393> in the smoke<WH06227>, and the sword<WH02719> shall devour<WH0398><WTH8799> thy young lions<WH03715>: and I will cut off<WH03772><WTH8689> thy prey<WH02964> from the earth<WH0776>, and the voice<WH06963> of thy messengers<WH04397> shall no more be heard<WH08085><WTH8735>.<CM>
